name: Proton VPN
author: jampick
description: Proton VPN state, quick connect, protection settings, and a country picker in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Connect and disconnect, switch country, change kill switch and NetShield, and see at a glance whether the tunnel is actually carrying your traffic and DNS.

schema.label: State poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar icon re-checks the tunnel. Cheap: reads NetworkManager and /sys, never the Proton CLI.

schema.label: Detail refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the open panel re-reads server load and settings from the Proton CLI. Only runs while the panel is open.
